title: empty-mask-conventions: code and per-image records for "When empty predictions win: Empty-mask conventions alter model rankings and evaluated subsets in medical image segmentation"

creators.name: Song, Yurong
creators.affiliation: College of Computer Science and Technology, Zhejiang Normal University

creators.name: Wu, Jianbin
creators.affiliation: College of Computer Science and Technology, Zhejiang Normal University

description:
Code, per-image evaluation records, split manifests, checkpoint provenance records and literature-audit materials for the paper When empty predictions win: Empty-mask conventions alter model rankings and evaluated subsets in medical image segmentation (submitted to Artificial Intelligence in Medicine).

Every table, in-text number and figure of the paper can be regenerated on a CPU from the released per-image records, and the test suite compares them with the paper. The repository also contains the full pipeline behind the records (PolypGen and SIIM-ACR preparation, the eight model architectures, training, inference and record extraction), the metric-library probe and the audit sheets. The PolypGen and SIIM-ACR images are not redistributed; they are available from their original sources.
